title: Catalyst applied to preparation of epoxidized soybean oil
abstract: The invention relates to the field of a fine chemical product catalyst, in particular to a catalyst applied to preparation of epoxidized soybean oil. The catalyst comprises magnesium doped aluminum oxide. The preparation process of the catalyst comprises the following steps: a, preparing a solution from magnesium salt and organic acid and dropwise adding the solution into an organic solvent solution of aluminum salt; b, after gelatinizing and ageing for a certain time, drying and roasting to obtain a product catalyst. By adoption of the technical scheme, the catalyst has the following beneficial effects: the catalyst can be used for performing catalytic epoxidation on soybean oil under the condition that only hydrogen peroxide exists, the use of a sulfuric acid and formic acid is avoided,the process is environmentally friendly, and the product is bright, good in color difference and easy to separate.
